decks.notes: This deck focuses on using cascade abilities to cheat out powerful creatures and spells, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck can efficiently ramp into big threats like Scion of Draco and Leyline of the Guildpact. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently, taking advantage of the synergy between cascade cards and high-impact spells. The deck aims to be aggressive and proactive, putting pressure on the opponent from the very beginning of the game.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of powerful counter spells, removal, and board wipes, while also utilizing The One Ring as a key win condition. The strategy involves disrupting the opponent's game plan, protecting your own key cards, and ultimately winning through the powerful effects of The One Ring. This deck aims to outlast the opponent, maintain board presence, and grind out a victory through careful play and strategic decision-making.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Hardened Scales enchantment to maximize the number of +1/+1 counters placed on creatures. This allows for aggressive plays with creatures like Arcbound Ravager and Walking Ballista, while also synergizing with cards like Zabaz, the Glimmerwasp and The Ozolith. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly by rapidly growing its creatures and utilizing artifact abilities to control the board. The inclusion of cards like Ancient Stirrings and Urza's Saga help to search for key pieces of the strategy, ensuring a consistent and powerful aggressive game plan.

The primary focus of this deck is to quickly establish board presence and apply pressure to the opponent while controlling the board with counterspells and removal. The key strategy revolves around using efficient creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to deal damage and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Murktide Regent provides a big threat in the late game, while cards like Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt help remove opposing threats. The deck aims to maintain a balance between aggression and control to secure a victory in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on aggressive creature-based strategies with a diverse range of colors to maximize efficiency and power. It utilizes Leylines to protect its creatures and Leyline of the Guildpact to boost their effectiveness. The deck also includes powerful creatures like Scion of Draco and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to quickly apply pressure on the opponent. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure consistent access to all required colors for its spells and creatures. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive game plan.

The deck focuses on utilizing Elementals to create a fast and aggressive gameplay style. Key cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Risen Reef help generate value and ramp up mana for explosive plays. Teferi, Time Raveler and Leyline Binding provide control and disruption options to protect the board state. The companion Kaheera, the Orphanguard adds an additional Elemental creature type synergies and strengthens the deck's overall game plan. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of efficient threats, removal, and card advantage to secure victory quickly.

The deck focuses on quickly reanimating powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Fallaji Archaeologist using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Ephemerate. It also includes a mix of disruption and removal spells like Prismatic Ending and Tainted Indulgence to control the game and protect the combo. The main goal is to set up a game-winning combo with Atraxa, Grand Unifier while utilizing instant speed reanimation to catch opponents off guard and disrupt their game plan. Additionally, the deck includes lands that provide utility and flexibility to adapt to different situations.

This deck focuses on using cards that mill the opponent's library, putting valuable cards into their graveyard while denying them resources. The key strategy involves using cards like Hedron Crab and Ruin Crab to repeatedly mill the opponent, and utilizing Archive Trap to punish them for searching their library. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Fatal Push and Drown in the Loch to control the board while continuing to mill. Ultimately, the goal is to deplete the opponent's library quickly and win through deck out, rather than traditional damage.

This deck focuses on utilizing a variety of colors to quickly overwhelm opponents with aggressive creatures and powerful spells. By maximizing the efficiency of its mana base and including cards that benefit from the different colors in the deck, such as Tribal Flames and Leyline of the Guildpact, this aggro deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently while maintaining a strong board presence. With the help of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion, this deck is able to consistently deploy threats and apply pressure to opponents in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

This deck focuses on aggressive creature strategies, utilizing a combination of powerful creatures and efficient spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The key concept revolves around utilizing a diverse range of creatures with varying abilities and mana costs, complemented by powerful spells like Tribal Flames and Lightning Bolt to deal direct damage and control the board. Leyline Binding and Stubborn Denial provide additional control elements to disrupt the opponent's strategy, while the inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds versatility to the deck's mana base. Overall, this deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain tempo throughout the game.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Atraxa using cards like Faithful Mending and Grief, then reanimating them using Goryo's Vengeance. The deck also utilizes instant spells like Ephemerate and Prismatic Ending for protection and removal. By combining the ability to reanimate creatures with powerful ETB effects and a suite of disruptive spells, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with powerful plays and generate a quick victory.

Utilize creatures with cycling abilities to fill up the graveyard quickly, then cast Living End to bring them back onto the battlefield for a powerful board presence. Use cards like Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent to cascade into Living End for maximum efficiency. Keep the opponent off balance with disruption from Force of Negation, Subtlety, and Grief while controlling the game with Curator of Mysteries and Waker of Waves. Use the versatility of creatures like Brazen Borrower and Architects of Will to further disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to disrupt opponents' strategies and control the board using cards like Blood Moon and Karn, the Great Creator, while also ramping up mana with Utopia Sprawl and accelerating card advantage with cards like Wrenn and Six. The deck aims to establish a strong board presence with creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and control the game with versatile removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Bonecrusher Giant. The deck also includes elements of graveyard hate and life gain with cards like Endurance and Klothys, God of Destiny.

This deck focuses on quickly cycling through your cards to get your combo pieces in the graveyard, then use Living End to bring back all your creatures and clear the board. The goal is to overwhelm your opponent with a large number of powerful creatures in a single turn, disrupting their strategy and gaining a significant advantage. The deck includes various ways to enable its combo, disrupt opponents' strategies, and protect itself from removal or counterspells, making it a versatile and powerful choice for Modern 1 vs 1 gameplay.

The deck relies on a toolbox of creatures to combo off and win the game. It utilizes creatures like Wall of Roots and Orcish Bowmasters to ramp up mana and control the board, while also using cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide to generate value and grind out opponents. The deck can also utilize Chord of Calling to tutor for specific creatures as needed. The key strategy is to assemble the right combination of creatures to create a powerful board presence and overwhelm the opponent.

This deck focuses on quickly and efficiently reanimating powerful creatures such as Griselbrand using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Fallaji Archaeologist. The goal is to set up explosive plays by combining instant reanimation with Atraxa, Grand Unifier to disrupt the opponent's game plan and overwhelm them with threats. The deck utilizes a mix of lands to fix mana and enable powerful combos, along with cards like Ephemerate and Faithful Mending to provide card advantage and consistency. Overall, the deck aims to win through aggressive combo plays and raw power.
